You see Latrivan.
  • I might reward you for killing my brother ~ with a swift death!
  • Colateral damage is so fun!
  • Golgordan you fool!
  • We are the brothers of fear!

Notes

The walls of the room is filled with Magicthrowers, Flamethrowers, Plaguethrowers and Shredderthrowers. Also Golgordan, his brother, is in the same room.

It's one of the bosses of The Inquisition Quest.
